description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gangodagama, Weligepola D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620142
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
